section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a single study (Study X) that examined the factorial and construct validity of a Standard Chinese translation of the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS-2) among 191 women and 154 men from mainland China resident in Hong Kong. The study found that the BAS-2 had a one-dimensional factor structure invariant across sex, good internal consistency, and significant correlations with self-esteem, life satisfaction, and (in women) weight discrepancy and BMI.
